# Impex Studios

> Toronto-based digital marketing and AI automation agency serving small to large businesses across Canada and the United States.

Contact: +1 (289) 608-9883 · contact@impexstudios.com · Mon–Fri 9am–6pm ET

## Services
- [Web design & development](https://impexstudios.com/services/web-design/): custom, fast websites. Landing page $499, 5-page site $999, 10-page business site $1,499, e-commerce $1,999. Fixed pricing, 50/50 payment.
- [SEO, local SEO & AI search](https://impexstudios.com/services/seo/): technical SEO, Google Business Profile, schema, content, generative engine optimization.
- [AI phone agents & automation](https://impexstudios.com/services/ai-automation/): AI receptionists, chatbots, CRM and n8n/Make workflow automation.
- [Social media marketing](https://impexstudios.com/services/social-media/): content, design, short-form video, community management, paid social.
